description: This file defines default configuration options for a FooTable component, including properties like 'rows', 'empty', 'showToggle', 'toggleSelector', 'toggleColumn', 'expandFirst', and 'expandAll'. It appears to set default parameters for how rows are handled and displayed within the FooTable plugin.

classes.name: Defaults
classes.description: A prototype object attached to the FooTable object for default configuration options related to row display and behavior.

methods.name: F.Defaults.prototype.rows = []; rows
methods.description: Contains the array of row data objects or a jQuery promise resolving to row data.

methods.name: F.Defaults.prototype.empty = 'No results'; empty
methods.description: A string to display when there are no rows in the table, default is 'No results'.

methods.name: F.Defaults.prototype.showToggle = true; showToggle
methods.description: Boolean indicating whether toggle controls are appended to each row, default true.

methods.name: F.Defaults.prototype.toggleSelector = 'tr,td,.footable-toggle'; toggleSelector
methods.description: CSS selector used to filter click events for toggling rows, default 'tr,td,.footable-toggle'.

methods.name: F.Defaults.prototype.toggleColumn = 'first'; toggleColumn
methods.description: Column in which the row toggle is displayed, supported values are 'first' or 'last', default 'first'.

methods.name: F.Defaults.prototype.expandFirst = false; expandFirst
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the first row details are expanded by default on small devices, default false.

methods.name: F.Defaults.prototype.expandAll = false; expandAll
methods.description: Boolean indicating if all row details are expanded by default on small devices, default false.
